source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: There are two sets of agreement markers in Sakha which can be used both in the nominal (nouns and adjectives) and verbal paradigms. What interests us is the nominal paradigm: set I markers (labelled as PRED) indicate finite predication, set II markers (labelled as POSS) – possession (as well as non-finite predication).
